notes.title: Kingdom of Dinza patch 1.2 is now live!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Knights!

The Kingdom of Dinza is celebrating its latest major patch - patch 1.2 which overhauls many aspects of the game for a far smoother gameplay experience. Additionally multiple bugs have been fixed and numerous quality of life improvements have been made.

We also offer a limited time discount for the game to make this celebration even more festive!

notes.title: Kingdom of Dinza celebrates first month with update
notes.notes:
Hello adventurers!

Kingdom of Dinza celebrates today a first full month of release with game update 1.13!

This update focuses on overhauling elements of the inventory system for easier player gaming.

We would like to thank everyone who joined us in this grand adventure so far and to those who are joining now - here's to all of you and to many more months of Kingdom of Dinza yet to come!

notes.title: Kingdom of Dinza to Release December 23rd
notes.notes:
Hello to all Knights eager for adventure!

Kingdom of Dinza will release on Steam tomorrow - December 23rd!

Sharpen your swords and your wits as you prepare to take your first steps into a mysterious new world!
